Mechatronics engineer with a master's degree in Renewable Energy, specializing in bioclimatic design, thermal comfort, and with an interest in solar thermal energy and automation. I work with Python for data acquisition, analysis, and visualization, developing reproducible and clear solutions. I am motivated by research and science, always seeking to combine technology with creativity to generate useful and humane projects.


## Education
- M.Sc. in Renewable Energy — IER‑UNAM (2023–2025)
- B.Eng. in Mechatronics — Universidad Tecnológica de Emiliano Zapata (UTEZ) (2018–2020)

## Experience
- Physics and Mathematics Teacher — NC School (2024–2025)
- HW/SW Developer (Thermal Comfort IoT) — IER‑UNAM (2023–2025)

## Highlights

### IoT smartwatch for thermal comfort
Open design based on XIAO ESP32C3, MAX30102, GY‑906; LVGL UI and ThingsBoard backend.
